finding.title: Buffer Overflow
finding.trigger: Passing an id with length 3 (two characters plus null terminator) to the constructor
finding.assumptions: The constructor expects a null-terminated string of length 2, but the provided string can be up to 3 characters long, including the null terminator.

parsed.refutation_attempt: Checked that the destination buffer _id has size 3 and the strncpy call copies at most 2 bytes (sizeof(_id)-1). The subsequent explicit null‑termination at index 2 guarantees the string is always null‑terminated. Since strncpy cannot write past the end of _id, no buffer overflow can occur, regardless of the length of the source string. Therefore the reported vulnerability is refuted.
